statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis is coded as I25.10 and R00.2
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic palpitations with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes
